steps.name: Open closed-for-season op
steps.do: Select **Set attraction as closed for the season**.
steps.expect: The form opens with **Attraction**, **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason**. There is no viewing scope.

steps.name: Submit with blank reason
steps.do: Select **Conservation Carousel**. Leave **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason** blank. Click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Conservation Carousel** was set as closed for the season.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Attractions**. Leave **Include closed attractions** unchecked.

steps.name: Season message
steps.do: Enable **Include closed attractions** and click **Conservation Carousel**.
steps.expect: **Conservation Carousel** appears with a light winter-blue background. The popup is blue with a snowflake, the same as an animal off display for the season, and reads **The Conservation Carousel is closed for the season.**

steps.name: Open-for-season lists season only
steps.do: In Console, open **Set attraction as open for the season** and expand **Attraction**.
steps.expect: **Conservation Carousel** is listed. The form has no start date or last day. An attraction that is only temporarily closed is not listed.

steps.name: Submit open for season
steps.expect: Success that **Conservation Carousel** was set as open for the season.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Attractions** enabled and **Include closed attractions** unchecked.
steps.expect: **Conservation Carousel** shows as a normal open attraction again.
